feeds.title: ACountry
feeds.description: ACountry focuses on enhancing the fan-artist relationship, including country music news, videos, photos, interviews, and concerts. ACountry is Just Like Being There - in the front row, backstage, on the tour bus, and behind the scenes with your favorite country music artists at premiere events.

feeds.title: Off Record Blog
feeds.description: Off Record Blog is a digital publication that praises all creatives in the realms of entertainment and music. Through our content, we aim to engage with readers while recognizing the underrepresented side of music and creative efforts that keep the media world alive.

feeds.title: Houston Music Review
feeds.description: Houston Music Review is Houston's Best Music Source Since 2001. Stay current on local musicians, performances, and venues at the Houston Press, your guide to the Houston music scene.

feeds.title: Houston Arts Journal Blog
feeds.description: Houston Arts Journal is an independent arts blog, created by me, Catherine Lu. This is my passion project to share art news, announcements, and opportunities across art forms and genres so that anyone interested in following the Houston arts scene can stay up-to-date with local developments.

feeds.title: Houstonia Magazine » Music
feeds.description: Launched in April 2013, no matter what part of town you prefer, what leisure activities you prefer, or what device you prefer, Houstonia magazine brings it all to you - the smartest, most authoritative, and up-to-the-minute take on the city you call home. The Music section on the website is a guide to Houston's vibrant music scene, including local band coverage and live concert news.

feeds.title: JMG Magazine » Music
feeds.description: With a passion for journalism, an ear for music, and a background in the publishing industry, Jacquari Harris, the founder of JMG (JBH Media Group, LLC), launched a full-scale print and digital entertainment magazine in 2009. JMG brings you the latest music news from local, regional, and international artists.

feeds.title: OutSmart Magazine
feeds.description: Established in 1994, OutSmart is an award-winning independent media ecosystem delivering local and national news to Houston's LGBTQ audience. OutSmart serves Houston's LGBTQ community, advancing our voices, visibility, representation, and interests while connecting our readers to culturally responsive, high-quality services and resources needed to thrive in Houston.

feeds.title: My Houston Gospel
feeds.description: My Houston Gospel is a news, entertainment, events & video website dedicated to Houston gospel music. Your source for Houston gospel music, news & more!

feeds.title: Houston Public Media » Music
feeds.description: Houston Public Media is a non-profit organization broadcasting through a multi-media platform to deliver content with a focus on Arts and Culture, Education, News and Information. Join the Houston Public Media community today!

feeds.title: Houston Style Magazine » Music
feeds.description: Houston Style Magazine has a 2020 weekly print circulation of 30,000 that reaches 130,000 active readers. Houston Style Magazine is distributed in over 600 metropolitan Houston locations, including the bustling counties of Harris and Fort Bend. Besides publishing the state of Texas's second-largest audited-circulation African-American weekly newspaper, Houston Style Magazine is well-respected for providing more relevant content than any other newspaper for the growing multicultural consumer market.

feeds.title: New Houston Music Outlet
feeds.description: New Houston Music Outlet is a blog that covers the Houston music scene, featuring news, reviews, and interviews. The blog was founded in 2020 and aims to support local artists and provide a platform for underrepresented voices in the music industry.

feeds.title: Housician Magazine
feeds.description: Housician Magazine is a free online magazine dedicated to promoting our city's talented rap, rock, and indie/pop artists with song/album spotlights & reviews, artist spotlights with interviews, featured music videos, and more!
